question: Nd:YAG laser capsulotomy is the definitive outpatient treatment for posterior capsule opacification (PCO) occurring after extracapsular cataract surgery.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is TRUE. Nd:YAG laser capsulotomy is the standard treatment for PCO. It uses pulsed photodisruption to create a central capsular opening, immediately restoring the visual axis without surgical incision. It is the most commonly performed laser procedure after cataract surgery.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. Nd:YAG laser creates a central opening in the opacified posterior capsule (secondary membrane) using photodisruption — a clean, non-invasive outpatient procedure that restores vision without a return to the operating room.
